Title: Epic 12 — User Type Foundation
Description: Make user_type a first-class dimension on users and build the shared plumbing Epics 13-17 depend on. Enum + parent_user_id, identity schemas, PATCH type endpoint, lifecycle events, PRD update. Decisions D1 (merchants-as-users) and D4 (store parent now, defer commission). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-03-user-types-design.md

Title: user_type enum + column migration + backfill
Description: PG enum user_type (consumer, agent, super_agent, merchant, head_merchant). users.user_type NOT NULL default consumer; migration backfills existing rows to consumer; index (tenant_id, user_type). Migration test asserts backfill and enum/constraint integrity. PRD: Pay-PRD-0010, 0080

Title: parent_user_id self-FK + hierarchy validation
Description: Nullable parent_user_id self-FK. Service validates agent -> super_agent, merchant -> head_merchant, same tenant; consumer/super_agent/head_merchant must have null parent. Invalid pairing -> 422 user_type_invalid_parent. Tests cover each pairing.

Title: Expose user_type + parent in identity schemas & detail
Description: Add user_type and parent_user_id to user create/detail Pydantic schemas and GET /users/{id}. Backwards compatible (defaults consumer). API test asserts round-trip.

Title: PATCH /users/{id}/type with audit + idempotency
Description: platform-admin only. Body {new_type, parent_user_id?, reason}; reason mandatory; Idempotency-Key honoured. Validations: parent compatibility; leaving a merchant type blocked while any merchant_collection balance != 0 -> user_type_transition_blocked; entering a merchant type requires merchant profile. Audit log before/after + reason. Emits user.type_changed post-commit. Tests: happy, 401, 403, 422, tenant isolation, idempotency replay.

Title: wallet.users.lifecycle topic + user.created/type_changed events
Description: Add topic to config.Topics and kafka/topics.sh (partitions 3, key user_id). Emit user.created and user.type_changed after DB commit; consumer idempotent via event_ingestion_log. Tests: emit-after-commit, partition key user_id, schema. NFR-0130.

Title: PRD Module 1 + glossary update for user types
Description: Document the 5 user types, hierarchy, and type-change flow in docs/02-prd.md Module 1 + glossary (section 3). Add Pay-PRD IDs for user types and cross-refs from Modules 5 (limits) and 6 (pricing).

Title: Epic 13 — Admin User Creation & Type Management
Description: Admin can create users (email or phone) with a user_type and change a user's type from the admin portal. Enables the disabled Phase G Register user button. Backend hardening + admin-ui dialogs following the limits-page pattern.

Title: Harden POST /users: email-or-phone, user_type, parent, merchant profile
Description: Extend admin create endpoint: at least one identifier (email or phone) required -> else identifier_required; accept user_type (default consumer), parent_user_id, and merchant profile payload when type is merchant/head_merchant. Idempotency-Key honoured; audit logged. Tests: happy (email-only, phone-only, both), 422 no-identifier, tenant isolation, idempotency.
Parent: Epic 13 — Admin User Creation & Type Management

Title: Admin create-user dialog
Description: Create-user dialog on the Users page (enables the disabled Register user button). Identifier type toggle (email/phone), profile fields, user_type selector, parent picker shown for agent/merchant types, merchant-profile fields for merchant types. Server action returns {ok} | {ok:false, errorCode, message} + revalidatePath. Follows limits CreateLimitDialog pattern.
Parent: Epic 13 — Admin User Creation & Type Management

Title: Change-type action + confirm/reason modal on user detail
Description: Change type action on the user detail card: confirm modal requiring a reason, calls PATCH /users/{id}/type. Hidden below platform-admin. Shows/links parent when set. Surfaces user_type_transition_blocked and invalid-parent errors.
Parent: Epic 13 — Admin User Creation & Type Management

Title: User-type badge + filter on users list
Description: user_type badge on user detail and lookup results; filter/segment users by type. Reuses StatusPill-style component.
Parent: Epic 13 — Admin User Creation & Type Management

Title: Server actions + API client wiring for create/change-type
Description: Add createUserAction and changeUserTypeAction server actions + typed API client functions and UserType TypeScript type mirroring the Pydantic enum. Wire into api-endpoints.ts / api-types.ts.
Parent: Epic 13 — Admin User Creation & Type Management

Title: Epic 14 — External User-Creation API
Description: Externally callable, OpenAPI-documented user-creation API for partners. Per-tenant API keys + HMAC request signing (Decision D3, reuses auth/hmac.py). Rate limited, idempotent, tenant derived from key. Security-reviewed.

Title: api_keys model + migration
Description: api_keys table: tenant_id, key_id, secret_hash (never plaintext), status, created_at, last_used_at. Secret shown once on creation. Tenant-scoped. Migration + tenant isolation test.

Title: API key management UI on Tenants screen
Description: API keys tab on the Tenants detail screen: create (show secret once), list, revoke. Follows existing tenant tabs layout.

Title: API-key + HMAC auth dependency
Description: FastAPI dependency verifying X-Sasai-Api-Key + X-Sasai-Signature (HMAC-SHA256, t=<unix>,v1=<hex>, 300s replay window via auth/hmac.py). Resolves tenant from the key. Error codes api_key_invalid, signature_invalid, signature_replayed. Tests: valid, bad key, bad signature, replayed, expired timestamp.

Title: POST /api/v1/external/users
Description: External create-user endpoint: same semantics as admin create; tenant from API key (never from payload); email or phone; Idempotency-Key required. Reuses identity.create_user service. Tests: happy, auth failures, 422, idempotency, cross-tenant rejection.

Title: Per-key rate limiting (Redis)
Description: Per-API-key rate limit on external endpoints (Redis token bucket). Exceed -> 429 rate_limited. Test asserts limit + reset.

Title: Curated OpenAPI external tag + exported partner spec
Description: Tag external endpoints; add curated request/response examples and the {error_code, message} envelope. Export the partner-facing OpenAPI spec into docs/ for distribution.

Title: Security review: external surface (STRIDE + OWASP API)
Description: security agent: STRIDE threat model + OWASP API Top 10 pass on API keys, HMAC, rate limiting, and external create. Sign-off required before merge (CLAUDE.md trigger: auth + money + PII).

Title: Epic 15 — Type-Aware Limits
Description: Make limit configs resolvable by user_type. Add nullable user_type to limit_configs and wallet_limit_configs (NULL = default for all types); exact-type row beats default at enforcement. Extends WAL-233..238 limits work.

Title: Add nullable user_type to limit_configs + wallet_limit_configs
Description: Migration adds nullable user_type to both tables; extend unique constraints with user_type using NULLS NOT DISTINCT (or paired partial unique indexes if local PG < 15 — decide in migration). Tenant isolation preserved. Migration test.

Title: Resolution precedence in limit enforcement
Description: Enforcement resolves exact (existing dims + caller user_type) first, else the user_type IS NULL default row (ORDER BY user_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 1). No per-user overrides. Applies to both service and wallet limits.

Title: Limits CRUD schema + router updates for user_type
Description: Add optional user_type to limit + wallet-limit create schemas and list/delete filters. Validation against the user_type enum. API tests.

Title: Limits UI: user_type column + selector
Description: Add user_type column (All types when NULL) and a user_type selector to the create dialogs on the Limits page.

Title: Precedence matrix tests for limits
Description: Tests for typed row vs NULL default vs no config, across service and wallet limits; confirm exact-type wins and default fallback works.

Title: Epic 16 — Type-Aware Pricing
Description: Make pricing/fees resolvable by user_type. Add nullable user_type to pricing_configs; quote_fee resolves exact-type first, else default. Mirrors Epic 15 for fees.

Title: Add nullable user_type to pricing_configs
Description: Migration adds nullable user_type to pricing_configs; extend unique constraint with user_type (NULLS NOT DISTINCT or paired partial indexes). Migration + tenant isolation test.

Title: quote_fee precedence resolution by user_type
Description: quote_fee resolves exact (existing dims + user_type) first, else user_type IS NULL default (ORDER BY user_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 1). Fee still quoted before ledger write (Pay-PRD-0260).

Title: Pricing CRUD schema + router updates for user_type
Description: Add optional user_type to pricing create schema + list/delete filters; validate against enum. API tests.

Title: Pricing UI: user_type column + selector
Description: Add user_type column (All types when NULL) and selector to the create dialog on the Pricing page.

Title: Precedence matrix tests for pricing
Description: Tests for typed row vs NULL default vs no config in quote_fee; confirm exact-type wins and default fallback.

Title: Epic 17 — Airtime Merchant Vertical
Description: First merchant vertical. Airtime merchant collects user funds into a merchant_collection ledger account, then provisions airtime via an external provider after commit. Uses merchants-as-users (D1). Builds on AirtimeRecharge model and airtime_merchant_holding groundwork. Depends on Epics 12, 15, 16.

Title: merchant_profiles model + migration
Description: merchant_profiles one-to-one with merchant/head_merchant users: user_id PK/FK, tenant_id, business_name, category, provider_config JSONB, settlement fields, timestamps. Created transactionally with the user or on type change into a merchant type. Migration + tenant isolation test.

Title: merchant_collection account type + provisioning
Description: Add merchant_collection account type constant. Provision one account per (tenant, merchant user, merchant_collection, currency) on merchant-profile creation, via existing partial unique index. Reuses accounts.user_id ownership.

Title: Airtime purchase flow: double-entry + pricing + limits
Description: Purchase posts one transaction: debit consumer financial_wallet, credit merchant merchant_collection, fee legs to system_fee_collected via type-aware pricing. Limits enforced with consumer user_type. AirtimeRecharge row created PENDING, linked to the transaction. Idempotency-Key. Ledger-invariant tests (entries balance, append-only).

Title: Provider adapter interface + Celery provisioning task
Description: After DB commit (NFR-0130), a Celery task calls the external airtime provider via an adapter interface (config from merchant_profiles.provider_config). Success -> recharge COMPLETED + event. Bounded retries with backoff. External call never inside the DB transaction.

Title: Failure reversal path + reconciliation hook
Description: On provisioning failure after retries: append a reversal transaction (merchant_collection -> consumer wallet; ledger stays append-only) and set recharge FAILED/REVERSED. Stuck PENDING recharges surface in the existing reconciliation queue. Reversal ledger-invariant test (net-zero).

Title: Events + ledger-invariant tests for airtime flow
Description: Provisioning outcomes ride wallet.transactions.completed with recharge status. automation-testing: ledger sum-to-zero, append-only, reversal correctness, idempotency, tenant isolation for the airtime flow.
